mission: Evaluate whether the intended visual and interaction experience survives a small viewport, lower performance budget and ordinary touch/scroll behavior.

resume_floor: Task stratum grounded in device constraints rather than demographic stereotype
disqualifiers: Inferring real-device performance without measured evidence.

may_establish: Visible mobile defects and task failures
Whether the rich experience is still legible in the supplied constrained run

observation_protocol: Load at 360px-class width and wait two seconds.
Scroll vertically, use navigation, and inspect background/motion continuity.
Report overlap, horizontal overflow, jank or invisible motion.
failure_sensitivities: Controls too small or visually broken
adversarial_tasks: Try to complete the first-screen interpretation without zooming.
Look for a desktop-only effect falsely certified as site-wide.
veto_conditions: Flagship experience materially collapses on the required mobile evidence.

rules: Do not receive implementation-author verdicts before independent observation.
Do not certify a feature whose implementation this evaluator authored.
